segments.text: I was one of the first people to have the COVID-19 vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I helped out in a vaccine centre.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03

segments.text: I was in Good Morning Britain helping tackle vaccine hesitancy.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03

segments.text: I did not conceive of the possibility that a vaccine could cause any real harm at all.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03

segments.text: It wasn't even anywhere in my brain.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03

segments.text: What we're dealing with now, with hindsight, is perhaps the greatest miscarriage of medical science we will witness in our lifetime.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03

segments.text: What in the world is going on?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: What's changed in the world all at the same time, all working to suppress the free interchange of information around SARS-CoV-2, COVID-19 and the vaccines?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Two of the world's biggest voices in heart health are now standing together discussing COVID and the vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: On November 29th, the Vaccine Safety Research Foundation presents Deep in the Heart of Texas with Dr. Peter McCullough and Dr. Racine Malhotra speaking live in Dallas along with a performance by Five Times August.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: Get your tickets now at backsafety.org slash events.
